Subject: Invoices for the last quarter
Body: Hello, our auditor has asked for copies of all invoices from the last quarter. I only have the email receipts and cannot find the PDF versions anywhere. Could you tell me where I can download them for our account? Thanks, Anna

Subject: CSV export fails with error EXP-4102
Body: Since Tuesday every attempt to export our campaign report to CSV stops after a few seconds with the message 'Export failed (EXP-4102)'. Exporting to PDF still works. I have attached two screenshots and the report id is RPT-88213. Can someone look into this?

Subject: Deactivate a leaver and reassign the seat
Body: One of our project managers, Mark Ellis, left the company on Friday. Please deactivate his user account and remove his access to all shared workspaces. We would like his seat moved to Priya Raman, who starts on Monday and will need a standard user role.

Subject: Quote for 40 additional licences
Body: We are expanding the platform to two more sites and need a quote for 40 additional licences on our current plan. Is there a volume price break at that quantity, and can the new licences be aligned to our existing contract end date? A formal quote on company letterhead would be appreciated.

Subject: Renewal date and auto-renewal
Body: Could you confirm the date on which our annual plan renews this year? We are reviewing all software subscriptions ahead of the new budget. Please also switch off auto-renewal on our account so that nothing is charged before our finance team has approved the renewal.

Subject: SSO sign-in failing for the whole team since your latest release
Body: Since your release notes went out yesterday evening, none of our users can sign in through SSO. The login page redirects to our identity provider, the user authenticates, and then the app shows a blank page. Your status page reports no outage. We suspect the new release changed the SAML handling, because nothing changed on our side. Fifty people are locked out.

Subject: Renewal quote is 30 percent higher than last year
Body: We received the renewal quote for next year and it is about 30 percent higher than what we paid last year, with no explanation. At that price we would have to consider moving to a lower tier or evaluating other vendors. We have been a customer for four years and would like someone to walk us through the options before we decide.

Subject: Erasure request under GDPR Article 17
Body: This is a formal request under Article 17 of the GDPR. Please erase all personal data you hold about me and the three users of our former account, and confirm in writing within 30 days that this has been done. If we do not receive confirmation by then we will refer the matter to the supervisory authority.

Subject: Phishing email impersonating your support team
Body: Several of our staff received an email this morning that claims to come from your support team and asks them to 'verify their account' through a link. The sender address is similar to yours but not identical, and the link goes to a domain we do not recognise. One person clicked it. We are reporting this so you can warn other customers.
